meta.title: Bill Formatter — XML Ingestion, Invoice Generation, Delivery & Configuration

lanes.name: Mediation Zone / Oracle BRM
lanes.hint: Upstream billing source supplying regular, trial and hot bill XML

lanes.name: Bill Formatter (DXP)
lanes.hint: Core engine — XML validation, parsing, batch creation, invoice generation, masking, reports

lanes.name: Bill Formatter Portal / Admin Console
lanes.hint: Batch, bill, hot bill, XML, search and configuration consoles used by Billing Operations

lanes.name: Billing Operations User
lanes.hint: Reviews failures, retries, configures templates and reference data, approves invoices

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Hot bill landing location, reprint/resend request origin, notification logging

lanes.name: Delivery Channels
lanes.hint: SMS, WhatsApp Business, Web and Email (via SMTP) to the customer

nodes.label: XML Ready in Mediation Zone
nodes.desc: Regular, trial and hot bill invoice XML becomes available at the Mediation Zone / Oracle BRM predefined input location for Bill Formatter to retrieve.

nodes.label: Retrieve XML (Regular / Trial / Hot)
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter pulls invoice XML from Mediation Zone/BRM for regular bills, trial bills and hot bills from the predefined file location. Retrieval uses atomic file handling (temp file, write, close, verify, then rename/move) so downstream systems never read a partially written file, and processes batch-wise with duplicate prevention and retrieval status logging.
inputs: Invoice XML at MZ predefined location (regular/trial/hot)
outputs: XML file moved to final destination

nodes.label: Manual XML/ZIP Upload
nodes.desc: Authorised Billing Operations users may manually upload XML or ZIP files as an alternative to automated Mediation Zone pickup.
outputs: XML file queued for batch creation

nodes.label: Validate XML (Schema + Mandatory Data)
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter loads the XML and performs schema validation to ensure file structure is valid, then validates mandatory billing information required for invoice generation. Only XML passing both checks proceeds to invoice generation; a failure is marked Failed XML with a recorded reason and made visible in the Bill Formatter Portal for reprocessing after corrective action.

branches.label: Failed XML — schema or data invalid

nodes.label: Failed XML — Portal Visibility & Reprocess
nodes.desc: Failed XML records (failed schema or mandatory data validation) are visible in the Bill Formatter Portal with the recorded failure reason. Billing Operations users review and initiate reprocessing after corrective action.
outputs: Reprocess request -> back to Retrieve XML

nodes.label: Parse & Load XML
nodes.desc: Parses the validated XML and loads the Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Detail structures, capturing a log for tracking of the loading process.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Detection
nodes.desc: Where a supporting CSV is expected for an XML but remains absent four hours after XML receipt, an alert email is issued to configured recipients. A scheduler checks every ten minutes.
outputs: Alert email if CSV absent after 4 hours

nodes.label: Create Batch
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter loads the received XML files (automated pickup or manual upload) and creates a processing batch for invoice generation; each collection cycle produces a single batch identifier.

nodes.label: Batch Console
nodes.desc: Provides Billing Operations users visibility of batch processing status, invoice generation status, email delivery status and XML processing status at both batch and bill level.

nodes.label: Batch Action Menu
nodes.desc: Batch-level action menu: View Bills, View Statistics, Overall Report, Detail Report, Failed Report, Failed Email Report, Send Overall Report, Send Email. Each option triggers its corresponding action.

nodes.label: Bill Action Menu (Batch Console)
nodes.desc: For a bill selected via View Bills from the Batch Console, the action menu offers 8 options: Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email. This same 8-option pattern recurs identically for Reprint Bill console rows and Hot Bill Details rows (represented separately in the Reprint/Hot Bill phase since those are distinct entry contexts).

nodes.label: Batch Reports (Overall / Detailed / Statistics)
nodes.desc: Overall Batch Report summarising each generated document, Detailed Batch Report with bill-level aggregation and service-level segregation, and batch statistics (successful/failed PDF generation with id, bill number, account number, status, reason).

nodes.label: Generate Invoice (Bill Type x Segment x Format)
nodes.desc: Generates invoice outputs per bill type (Regular / Trial / Hot), customer segment (Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black, Bulk SMS, IoT) and output format (PDF for all segments; XLS and CSV additionally for Enterprise), in English or Arabic per the language identifier in the source data. Regular and Hot bill PDFs for Enterprise/Black are sent to Siebel; Trial bills are generated for internal audit only and never distributed.

nodes.label: Invoice Generation Failed — Retry
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter identifies invoices that failed during processing or generation, records the failure status and reason, and makes it visible in the Bill Formatter Portal. Billing Operations reviews and initiates reprocessing; reprocessing is restricted by role and the retry count is recorded.
outputs: Retry request -> back to Generate Invoice

nodes.label: Hot Bill Generation Failed Alert
nodes.desc: Identifies failed hot bill generation and sends an email alert/report, running at a configured four-hour interval and checking uploaded hot bills for failed status.

nodes.label: Review & Approve Invoice
nodes.desc: Role-based Billing Operations users may review generated invoices/documents and approve or reject them before customer dispatch. Access to this review step is governed by an on/off switch defaulted to OFF.

nodes.label: Regenerate Invoice
nodes.desc: Billing Operations initiates regeneration for a specific invoice or batch. Bill Formatter validates the selection, retrieves the latest/corrected XML if available (including from the legacy Invoice Buffer table for historical invoices), regenerates the required output (PDF/XLS/CSV) using the applicable template, and updates status making the regenerated invoice available for distribution, download or review.
inputs: latest/corrected XML or legacy Invoice Buffer data

nodes.label: Make Invoice Available to Channels
nodes.desc: After successful invoice processing, Bill Formatter makes the generated invoice output available to downstream channels through the configured integration flow. Regular Bills: invoice copies made available to Siebel and other customer channels. Hot Bills: invoice placed in the Siebel Hot Bill landing location, available in real time. Trial batches are excluded from channel upload.
outputs: Invoice copy to Siebel + customer channels

nodes.label: Apply Masking Before Despatch
nodes.desc: Customer-specific masking rules are applied to the invoice before despatch through any communication channel.

nodes.label: Multi-Channel Invoice Communication
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter supports invoice communication through SMS, WhatsApp Business, Web and Email, carrying a PDF reference or an invoice URL.

nodes.label: Determine Email Eligibility & Template
nodes.desc: Only successfully generated invoices are eligible for email distribution; trial invoices are never emailed. Bill Formatter determines the applicable email template by customer type, invoice type and language.

nodes.label: Send Invoice Email (SMTP)
nodes.desc: Attaches the generated invoice document (PDF/XLS/CSV as applicable) and despatches through the configured SMTP service, which captures delivery feedback. Addresses on the configurable suppression (non-triable) list are skipped.

nodes.label: Failed Email — Report & Retry
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter generates a Failed Bills/Failed Email Report (account number, bill number, status, reason) for bills/emails that failed to send, and reports successful/failed email totals per batch, account-wise and bill-wise. Delivery is retried on resend.

nodes.label: CRM Notification Logging
nodes.desc: After an invoice email is sent, Bill Formatter creates a notification log entry (invoice reference + email communication details) and sends it to Siebel CRM, which stores the record against the customer account and bill reference for servicing and audit.
outputs: CRM notification record stored against account/bill reference

nodes.label: Invoice Delivered
nodes.desc: Invoice successfully delivered to the customer through the eligible channel(s) and logged for servicing/audit.

nodes.label: Reprint Request from CRM
nodes.desc: Siebel CRM sends a bill reprint request carrying account number, bill period and bill type. Bill Formatter retrieves the XML, generates the PDF, and transfers it through the Mediation Zone back to CRM for the customer. Reprint does not alter original invoice data — only a previously generated bill may be reprinted. Existing API signature is preserved for parallel running.
inputs: Reprint request: account number, bill period, bill type
outputs: Reprinted PDF via Mediation Zone to Siebel

nodes.label: Reprint Bill Console
nodes.desc: Displays reprint request details with Bill type (Detailed/Summarised) and Language (English/Arabic) selection, and a dedicated register showing status and process date for reprint requests.

nodes.label: Reprint Bill Action Menu
nodes.desc: Same 8-option action menu pattern as the Batch Console bill action menu (Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email), applied in the Reprint Bill register context.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Register
nodes.desc: Displays the hot bill register: id, process date, bill number, status, email, total size, this month due, total due, and an action menu.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Action Menu
nodes.desc: Same 8-option action menu pattern (Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email), applied to Hot Bill Details.

nodes.label: Resend Request from Customer/CRM
nodes.desc: Customer requests a bill resend through Siebel CRM for a previously generated invoice. Siebel invokes the Bill Formatter Resend Bill service with account number and bill reference. Bill Formatter validates the reference, retrieves the previously generated document, applies the (separately maintainable) Resend Email Template, and sends the invoice. Only a previously generated invoice may be resent.

nodes.label: Resend Invoice Email
nodes.desc: Sends the invoice PDF/XLS to the customer email address using the Resend Email Template and records the delivery status. If delivery fails, the failure status is recorded and displayed in the Bill Formatter Portal for operational review.

nodes.label: Resend Bill Status Console
nodes.desc: Shows resend bill status (Sl No, Bill Number, Status, Process Date) in a dedicated console option, with an action menu to Edit the Resend Bill Template.

nodes.label: Invoice & Report Search
nodes.desc: Supports invoice/report search across twelve filters (invoice type, invoice number, batch, date, language, MSISDN, product, status, email, account, customer type, BF internal id). Results support download, regenerate, reprocess and email actions, availability governed by role and invoice status.

nodes.label: XML Record Search
nodes.desc: Search uploaded bill XML records by Invoice Type, Invoice Number, Batch ID and XML Status, showing latest processing status and offering Operational Log, Download XML and Regenerate XML actions.
inputs: Invoice type, invoice number, batch ID, XML status
outputs: Operational Log / Download XML / Regenerate XML actions

nodes.label: Generate Reports (Enterprise / Operational / Business)
nodes.desc: Billing users generate billing reports themselves — Enterprise reports (CDR List, Credit File, Invoice Report) for configured large enterprise accounts using predefined XML mappings, operational reports, and other agreed business reports — and distribute them to specific email addresses or distribution lists, in PDF, CSV or Excel, on daily/monthly/after-bill-run/ad hoc frequency. No output is produced for print media.
inputs: Report type, template, trigger/frequency, configured accounts

nodes.label: Download / Export Report
nodes.desc: Allows report download or export in PDF and Excel formats for Billing Operations users.

nodes.label: Operational Dashboard & Statistics
nodes.desc: Admin Console dashboard defaults to the current month, presenting large bills, failed XML files, resend/reprint counts (daily/monthly/yearly), total accounts, average bill size (Consumer/Enterprise), batch list information and unsent batch emails; plus a Statistics Report for XML processing (uploaded vs processed counts, monthly statistics, batch statistics, real-time batch status).

nodes.label: Billing Reports Accounts Manager
nodes.desc: Business Users configure, modify or delete report types per account number (Account Name, Report Type, List of Account Numbers). Enterprise billing reports are generated only for accounts configured here.
inputs: Account name, report type, account number list

nodes.label: Admin Console — Centralised Configuration
nodes.desc: Front-end Admin Console for Billing Operations covering batches, bills, hot bills, XML records, reports, translations, billing settings and role-based access. Configuration records drill down centrally — selecting a batch id opens the invoices belonging to that batch, and configuration records open in a separate window/pop-up.

nodes.label: Reference Data Configuration
nodes.desc: Maintains translation values (auto-created from new source XML values), adjustment reason code-to-label mappings, benefit configurations against billing products, Flex Bucket identifiers, VAS short code mappings, and Plan Speed configuration for fibre/FWA plans — each with create/modify/delete/search and, where applicable, import/export and product-catalogue synchronisation. Includes the create/search/action-menu sub-options for each reference data type.
outputs: Maintained translation, adjustment reason, benefit, flex bucket, VAS, plan speed data used at invoice generation

nodes.label: Configuration Import / Export & Effective Dating
nodes.desc: Configuration data is exportable and importable in XLS and CSV format; configuration records carry an Active From/Active To date and activate or deactivate automatically. Configuration maintenance is role-controlled.

nodes.label: Bill Template & Banner Configuration
nodes.desc: Maintains invoice templates by customer segment and invoice type (Consumer, Enterprise, Bulk SMS, Black, IoT) — fields may be changed, added, removed or repositioned by an authorised role. Also covers bill banner configuration (by language/customer type, deactivatable, overlap-safe pagination), interactive PDF tabs/dynamic links, and email/resend template configuration (separately maintainable in English and Arabic).
outputs: Updated invoice/email/banner template used at generation and delivery

nodes.label: Report Template Configuration
nodes.desc: Report templates (recipient mail id, subject, body, trigger dates) are maintainable per report — Bill Run Monitor, VLB, Overall, Internal, Video Bill — and used when generating/sending the associated report.
outputs: Configured report template used by report generation

nodes.label: Masking Rule Configuration
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter generates and stores the original (immutable) invoice, plus a separate masked invoice file per configured masking rules (Tax Identifier, Payment Method, Phone Number). User role/access permission determines whether the full or masked invoice is presented; masking rules are configurable without regenerating the invoice for presentation-time rules. Bill download offers Agent Copy (summarised or masked, each independently toggleable) and Customer Copy.

nodes.label: Platform Services Configuration
nodes.desc: Storage and retention with automatic housekeeping of artefacts past their retention period; multi-language support (English/Arabic template + translation values); multi-currency support (line items shown in respective currency); tax information processing during generation; calculated fields populated using supplied billing-system logic; and compatibility handling for old/legacy invoice formats.
inputs: Retention policy, language/currency/tax settings, legacy format rules
outputs: Storage housekeeping, language/currency/tax application at generation, calculated field values

nodes.label: Template Business-Rule Documentation
nodes.desc: All invoice field definitions, rules and business logic governing the invoice template are exposed and made accessible to non-technical users in a business-readable format, matching the current template's documentation.

nodes.label: Invoice Rejected / Exception Terminal
nodes.desc: Terminal state for an invoice that failed generation beyond retry, or was permanently rejected and not further regenerated within scope of this process — recorded with its failure/rejection reason for audit.

start.title: XML Ready in Mediation Zone
start.does: Oracle BRM/Mediation Zone produces the invoice XML for a bill cycle (regular), a nominated trial run, or a hot bill trigger, and places it at the predefined input location.
start.needs: Billing cycle event, trial run trigger, or hot bill trigger
start.makes: Invoice XML file at the MZ input location

xml_retrieve.title: Retrieve XML (Regular / Trial / Hot)
xml_retrieve.does: Pulls invoice XML from MZ/BRM for regular, trial and hot bills using an atomic write-then-rename pattern so no partial file is ever read downstream; processes batch-wise, prevents duplicate processing, and logs retrieval status.
xml_retrieve.needs: Invoice XML at MZ predefined location
xml_retrieve.makes: Retrieved XML file ready for validation; retrieval log entry
xml_retrieve.example: BFR_SEQ_001; BFR_SEQ_003; BFR_SEQ_004; BR-001; BR-002; BR-003; BR-004; BR-005

xml_manual_upload.title: Manual XML/ZIP Upload
xml_manual_upload.does: Authorised users can manually upload XML or ZIP files instead of relying on automated MZ pickup.

xml_validate.title: Validate XML (Schema + Mandatory Data)
xml_validate.does: Loads the XML, checks schema validity and mandatory billing data. Passing files move to invoice generation; failing files are marked Failed XML with a reason, visible in the portal for review and reprocessing.
xml_validate.makes: Valid XML forwarded to parsing, or Failed XML record with reason
xml_validate.example: BFR_SEQ_002; BR-009; BR-010; Status_Model: XML Record Received->Valid/Failed XML

xml_failed.title: Failed XML — Portal Visibility & Reprocess
xml_failed.does: Shows failed XML records with their failure reason in the portal so Billing Operations can correct the source data and trigger reprocessing.
xml_failed.example: BR-009; BR-010; Status_Model: XML Record Failed XML -> Received on reprocessing

xml_parse.title: Parse & Load XML
xml_parse.does: Parses valid XML and loads Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Detail data structures, logging the load for traceability.

csv_watch.title: Supporting CSV Detection
csv_watch.does: Watches for an expected supporting CSV file; if it hasn't arrived four hours after the XML, alerts the configured recipients (checked every 10 minutes).

batch_create.title: Create Batch
batch_create.does: Groups the loaded XML files from a collection cycle into a single processing batch with its own batch identifier.

batch_console.title: Batch Console
batch_console.does: Gives Billing Operations a status view of every batch and the bills within it — XML, invoice generation and email delivery status.

batch_action_menu.title: Batch Action Menu
batch_action_menu.does: Single menu offering the 8 batch-level actions (view bills/statistics, the 4 report types, send overall report, send email).

bill_action_menu.title: Bill Action Menu (Batch Console)
bill_action_menu.does: Per-bill action menu reached from Batch Console > View Bills, offering status log, PDF/XLS/XML download, reprint, regenerate document/XML, and send email.
bill_action_menu.makes: Triggered bill-level action (log, download, reprint, regenerate, email)
bill_action_menu.example: BFR_SEQ_016; BFR_SEQ_018; BFR_SEQ_019-026; BR-075; BR-076; BR-077

batch_reports.title: Batch Reports (Overall / Detailed / Statistics)
batch_reports.does: Produces the Overall and Detailed batch reports and the batch statistics view (successful vs failed generation) for a selected batch, downloadable in XLS.

invoice_generate.title: Generate Invoice (Bill Type x Segment x Format)
invoice_generate.does: Extracts the applicable template by segment and language and renders the invoice as PDF (and XLS/CSV for Enterprise) for Regular, Trial and Hot bills across Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black, Bulk SMS and IoT.
invoice_generate.example: BFR_SEQ_035-060; BR-020 to BR-028; Status_Model: Invoice Pending->Generated

invoice_gen_failed.title: Invoice Generation Failed — Retry
invoice_gen_failed.does: Surfaces invoices that failed generation with a reason in the portal; a role-restricted Billing Operations retry re-attempts generation and records the retry count.
invoice_gen_failed.example: BFR_SEQ_037; BFR_SEQ_061; BR-029; BR-030; Status_Model: Invoice Failed -> Pending on reprocessing

hotbill_failed_report.title: Hot Bill Generation Failed Alert
hotbill_failed_report.does: Runs on a schedule to detect failed hot bill generation and email an alert so operations can react quickly given the real-time nature of hot bills.

invoice_review.title: Review & Approve Invoice
invoice_review.does: Billing Operations searches for the generated invoice, reviews content and status, then approves (proceeds to dispatch) or rejects (sends back for regeneration) it. Controlled by an on/off switch, default OFF.
invoice_review.example: BFR_SEQ_063; BFR_SEQ_092; BR-080; P-12; Status_Model: Invoice Generated->Approved/Rejected

invoice_regenerate.title: Regenerate Invoice
invoice_regenerate.does: Re-runs invoice generation for a specific invoice or batch, consuming the latest corrected XML (or historical data from the legacy Invoice Buffer table) so even multi-year-old invoices can be reproduced.
invoice_regenerate.needs: Regeneration request, source XML (current or legacy buffer)
invoice_regenerate.example: BFR_SEQ_062; BFR_SEQ_091; BR-040; BR-041; BR-042; Status_Model: Invoice Rejected->Pending on regeneration

channel_avail.title: Make Invoice Available to Channels
channel_avail.does: Publishes the generated invoice to downstream channels — Siebel and other customer channels for Regular Bills, the Siebel Hot Bill landing location in real time for Hot Bills. Trial batches never reach channels.
channel_avail.makes: Invoice available at Siebel/channel landing points

invoice_masking_dispatch.title: Apply Masking Before Despatch
invoice_masking_dispatch.does: Applies the customer's masking rules to sensitive invoice fields immediately before the invoice is sent out through SMS/WhatsApp/Web/Email.
invoice_masking_dispatch.makes: Masked invoice content for the channel

multi_channel_send.title: Multi-Channel Invoice Communication
multi_channel_send.does: Sends the invoice notification via SMS, WhatsApp Business and Web channel (PDF reference or invoice URL); Email is handled by the dedicated Email Distribution node with its own delivery-status lifecycle.

email_eligibility.title: Determine Email Eligibility & Template
email_eligibility.does: Checks that the invoice was successfully generated and is not a trial invoice, then selects the applicable email template by customer type, invoice type and language.
email_eligibility.example: BFR_SEQ_094; BFR_SEQ_185; BR-060; BR-061; Status_Model: Email Eligible->Sent/Suppressed

email_send.title: Send Invoice Email (SMTP)
email_send.does: Attaches the invoice document and sends the email via the configured SMTP service, skipping addresses on the suppression list, and captures the SMTP delivery feedback.

email_failed.title: Failed Email — Report & Retry
email_failed.does: Captures SMTP failure feedback, reports it in the Failed Email/Failed Bill Report, and supports resend so delivery can be retried.
email_failed.example: BFR_SEQ_109; BFR_SEQ_148; BFR_SEQ_011/064; BR-063; Status_Model: Email Sent->Failed; Failed->Sent on resend

crm_notify_log.title: CRM Notification Logging
crm_notify_log.does: Logs the email delivery outcome into a CRM notification record, stored by Siebel against the customer account and bill reference for future servicing and audit.

end_delivered.title: Invoice Delivered
end_delivered.does: Terminal state: the invoice has reached the customer via at least one channel and the delivery has been logged.
end_delivered.example: Status_Model: Invoice Email Sent (Terminal); Email Delivered (Terminal)

reprint_request.title: Reprint Request from CRM
reprint_request.does: Siebel CRM raises a reprint request (account, bill period, bill type); Bill Formatter regenerates the PDF from the original XML and routes it back through the Mediation Zone to Siebel, without altering the original invoice.
reprint_request.needs: Account number, bill period, bill type
reprint_request.makes: Reprinted PDF returned via Mediation Zone

reprint_console.title: Reprint Bill Console
reprint_console.does: Shows the reprint request register with status and process date, letting the operator pick Detailed/Summarised presentation and English/Arabic language.

reprint_action_menu.title: Reprint Bill Action Menu
reprint_action_menu.does: The standard 8-option bill action menu, offered against entries in the Reprint Bill register.

hotbill_console.title: Hot Bill Register
hotbill_console.does: Lists hot bills with their key billing and status attributes and exposes the bill action menu per entry.

hotbill_action_menu.title: Hot Bill Action Menu
hotbill_action_menu.does: The standard 8-option bill action menu, offered against entries in the Hot Bill Register.

resend_request.title: Resend Request from Customer/CRM
resend_request.does: A customer-initiated resend request via Siebel CRM (account + bill reference) triggers Bill Formatter to retrieve the previously generated invoice and prepare it for delivery using the resend-specific template.
resend_request.needs: Account number, bill reference (previously generated invoice)

resend_send.title: Resend Invoice Email
resend_send.does: Delivers the resend email (PDF/XLS) and records status; on failure, the failure is recorded and surfaced in the portal for operational review.
resend_send.example: BFR_SEQ_187; BR-047; Status_Model: Batch Failed Sending Email -> Email Sent on retry

resend_console.title: Resend Bill Status Console
resend_console.does: A dedicated register of resend attempts with status/date, plus the ability to edit the resend email template.
resend_console.makes: Resend status view; template edit action

invoice_search.title: Invoice & Report Search
invoice_search.does: Lets Billing Operations find invoices/reports using any of 12 filters and act on results (download in PDF/XML/XLS/CSV, regenerate, reprocess, email) subject to role and status.

xml_search.title: XML Record Search
xml_search.does: Finds uploaded XML records by type/number/batch/status and offers the operational log, download and regenerate actions.

reports_generate.title: Generate Reports (Enterprise / Operational / Business)
reports_generate.does: Produces Enterprise, operational and business reports on the configured frequency/format and distributes them by email to configured recipients or distribution lists.
reports_generate.needs: Report template, trigger schedule, configured accounts
reports_generate.makes: Generated report file, sent to distribution list
reports_generate.example: BFR_SEQ_104; BFR_SEQ_106; BFR_SEQ_111; BR-130; BR-131; BR-133

reports_download.title: Download / Export Report
reports_download.does: Lets operations download or export a generated report in PDF or Excel.

dashboard.title: Operational Dashboard & Statistics
dashboard.does: Gives operations a current-month graphical view of large bills, failed XMLs, resend/reprint counts, average bill size, and XML processing statistics.

reports_account_mgr.title: Billing Reports Accounts Manager
reports_account_mgr.does: Business users maintain which large-enterprise accounts get which report type; only configured accounts get Enterprise reports.
reports_account_mgr.needs: Account name, report type, account numbers

config_console.title: Admin Console — Centralised Configuration
config_console.does: The single console surface Billing Operations uses to reach every configuration area, with drill-down from batch to its invoices.

config_reference_data.title: Reference Data Configuration
config_reference_data.does: Business users maintain translations, adjustment reasons, benefits, flex buckets, VAS short codes and plan speed values that invoice generation reads at render time; some sync automatically from the product catalogue or auto-create from new source XML values.
config_reference_data.needs: New source XML values, product catalogue sync
config_reference_data.makes: Reference data consumed by invoice generation
config_reference_data.example: BFR_SEQ_116-121; BFR_SEQ_129; BFR_SEQ_172-181; BR-100 to BR-108

config_import_export.title: Configuration Import / Export & Effective Dating
config_import_export.does: Lets authorised users bulk import/export configuration in XLS/CSV, and configuration records self-activate/deactivate on their Active From/To dates.

config_templates.title: Bill Template & Banner Configuration
config_templates.does: Authorised users redesign invoice templates per segment/invoice type, configure banners and interactive PDF features, and maintain the separate email/resend templates in English and Arabic.
config_templates.example: BFR_SEQ_121; BFR_SEQ_122; BFR_SEQ_125; BFR_SEQ_138; BFR_SEQ_139; BFR_SEQ_188; BR-120 to BR-124; BR-048

config_report_templates.title: Report Template Configuration
config_report_templates.does: Business users define the recipient list, subject, body and trigger schedule for each report type so scheduled reports go out correctly formatted and addressed.
config_report_templates.makes: Configured template consumed by report generation

config_masking_rules.title: Masking Rule Configuration
config_masking_rules.does: Keeps the original invoice untouched while producing a masked variant per configurable rules; presentation (which copy a role sees) is decided at access time, not generation time.
config_masking_rules.needs: Original invoice, masking policy, requesting user's role
config_masking_rules.makes: Masked invoice + role-based presentation, Agent/Customer copy options

config_platform.title: Platform Services Configuration
config_platform.does: Covers the platform-level, cross-cutting settings — retention/housekeeping, language, currency, tax and calculated-field logic, and legacy invoice compatibility — that invoice generation depends on.
config_platform.example: BFR_SEQ_098; BFR_SEQ_135-141; BFR_SEQ_146; BR-160 to BR-163

config_template_docs.title: Template Business-Rule Documentation
config_template_docs.does: Publishes the invoice template's field definitions and business rules in a business-readable form so non-technical users can understand the template without reading code.

end_rejected.title: Invoice Rejected / Exception Terminal
end_rejected.does: Represents the terminal exception outcome for an invoice/XML that could not be successfully processed to delivery — its failure reason remains on record in the portal.
end_rejected.example: Status_Model: XML Record Failed XML; Invoice Failed; Invoice Rejected
